entities.summary: Nicklas Utgren, is a former professional tennis player from Sweden. He enjoyed most of his tennis success while playing doubles. During his career he won 1 doubles title. He achieved a career-high doubles ranking of world No. 55 in 1990. He ended his career when he was 27 years old. Nicklas Utgren was a athletes & competitors from Vänersborg (b. 1969-01-12, Vänersborg). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
